A mutex is like a digital lock that ensures only one thread can access a specific resource at any given time to prevent data corruption when multiple threads try to modify it simultaneously. It works by locking and unlocking the resource so other threads have to wait their turn if they need access, ensuring safe concurrent execution without conflicts or race conditions in multi-threaded programs.
